headline: A Change Stream fires on that insert and hands the document to Jev, which sorts it into a topic bucket with a confidence score.

media.alt: Video from the post by George Qiao

text:
I got access to Jev, a new low-latency LLM from TypeSafe, so I built something real to find out what it's actually good for: a live customer care triage dashboard called Care Desk Live.
